newsitem.title: USA: Allmerica Financial to buy rest of insurer.
newsitem.headline: Allmerica Financial to buy rest of insurer.

text.p: Allmerica Financial Corp on Wednesday said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Allmerica Property & Casualty Cos Inc for about $800 million.
Under the deal, Allmerica Financial would acquire the 40.5 percent of Allmerica Property that it did not already own, or 24.2 million shares, for $33 each.
The deal is expected to close in the third quarter of 1997.

"This combination allows Allmerica Financial to allocate capital more flexibly among operations and will enable us to further focus attention on enhancing long-term shareholder value," Chief Executive John O'Brien said in a statement.

Under the terms, shareholders of Allmerica Property will have the right to receive $17.60 in cash and 0.40 shares of Allmerica Financial common stock in exchange for each share of Allmerica Property, the company said.

If Allmerica Financial's 10-day average closing stock price prior to the completion of the merger falls to less than $36 a share or increases to more than $41 a share, the cash component of the merger consideration will be adjusted so that the value received by Allmerica Property shareholders in the exchange is no less than $32 a share and no greater than $34, it said.
Allmerica Financial shares slipped 1/2 to 37-7/8 on Wednesday, while Allmerica Property shares were unchanged at 31-3/8.

In addition, in lieu of receiving the specified combination of cash and stock, shareholders of Allmerica Property may elect to receive consideration either entirely in the form of cash or entirely in common shares of Allmerica Financial.
A total of about 9.67 million shares of Allmerica Financial common stock is to be issued to Allmerica Property shareholders as part of the merger transaction.
